text:
Nora (marketing PM): Heads up 1A Stargazer case draft is in Drive. Need legal OK + customer signoff by Fri 3pm if we want to include quotes in next Wednesday's launch. Also coordinating a co-hosted webinar on May 21  who can own registration, landing page, and invites?

Diego (producer): Ill take the landing page + assets. Proposed timeline: hero quote by Tue noon, transcript edits Tue afternoon, design polish Wed morning.

Priya (legal): Drop the exact quote copy here. Any numeric claims need backup or we soften. Also confirm written logo/media permission.

Nora (marketing PM): Two quote versions from the call below (A verbatim, B short).

Diego (producer): ```Quote A: "After adopting Redwood, we cut our inference bill by 68% and p99 latency dropped ~45%, which let us ship features in days."```

Priya (legal): Flags: "68%" and "~45%" and "p99" are quant. If we don't attach the benchmark appendix, change to non-numeric phrases: "a substantial reduction in inference costs" and "material p99 latency improvements." Also change "ship features in days" -> "accelerate feature delivery." Need signed media release for logo and a signed quote approval.

Hanna (growth): For inbound routing, can we tag demo signups with stargazer_launch and route to stargazer_sdr? I'll add a two-email nurture. Also we need UTM params for the webinar landing page.

announce-bot: Created ticket MKT-1720: "Stargazer case legal review & webinar setup" and assigned to Diego.

Diego (producer): Short hero candidate: "Stargazer reduced inference costs and accelerated rollouts with Redwood."

Priya (legal): Short hero ok with edits: change "reduced inference costs" -> keep, replace "accelerated rollouts" -> "accelerated model rollouts." Final: "Stargazer reduced inference costs and accelerated model rollouts with Redwood." Pending signed quote and logo permission.

Nora (marketing PM): Great. @Hanna confirm the SDR queue exists and add opt-in language for webinar signups. @Diego I need the hero in Figma by Wed 9am. I'll ping the customer for signoff now.

Hanna (growth): Confirmed stargazer_sdr exists. Opt-in snippet: "By registering you agree to be contacted by Redwood about product updates and demos." UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=stargazer_launch

Diego (producer): Figma link: https://redwood.app/figma/stargazer-case-hero  I'll drop hero + social + webinar banner frames by Tue noon.

Priya (legal): Approved as edited. :white_check_mark: Waiting on signed media release and customer confirmation of the quote wording.

Nora (marketing PM): Thanks team  I'll update when customer signs off and then schedule publish + send invites. Please react when you see this."
